newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia skills seen in ship maintenance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia skills seen in ship maintenance.

text.p: Australian shipbuilding industry growth over the next decade would come from the skilled maintenance area, an industry report said on Thursday.
"Australian opportunities are more likely to lie in skilled maintenance and repair of machinery and high technology equipment," the Australian Maritime Industries report said.
It said while total demand for new ships was expected to increase significantly over the next decade, the impact on Australian steel shipbuilding would be limited.
Korea and Japan would continue to dominate this area with some competition from European shipbuilding yards, it said.
The report said China was also likely to emerge as a competitor in the steel shipbuilding area.
"Australia is unlikely to contest this market, except possibly in a few niche areas," it said.
It said Asian shipbuilding yards were forecast to increase their one-third share of the ship repair and conversion market.

"Australian yards wishing to tap into this market, particularly in relation to labour intensive work such as hull cleaning and painting, will need to adopt modern labour-saving processes," the report said.
